verdict.rationale: The evidence describes cloud storage of digitized mail, online access to digital copies, and APIs that keep documents 'in sync' with other tools. None of it documents a bulk export of scan PDFs and mail-history metadata. API sync is a developer building block and storage is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for a bulk-export capability.

support.subject: As an operator, I can export my scans and mail history in bulk — PDFs and metadata leave the platform when I do
